es: Plantear contingencias con Should + sujeto + verbo base, in the event of / in the event that y failing that, y leer un plan de contingencia sencillo.

vocabulary.es: si eso falla, en su defecto

teaching.en: Should demand fall, we will draw on the cash reserve to pay the rent, and that reserve is our first safeguard.
teaching.es: Si la demanda bajara, recurriremos a la reserva de efectivo para pagar el alquiler, y esa reserva es nuestra primera salvaguarda.
teaching.explanationEs: Should + sujeto + verbo base sustituye a if; draw on = recurrir a algo que ya se tiene.
segments: Should demand fall, we will draw on the cash reserve to
pay the rent, and that reserve is our first safeguard.
teaching.audioText: Should demand fall, we will draw on the cash reserve to pay the rent, and that reserve is our first safeguard.

teaching.en: In the event of a supplier delay, we will fall back on a local shop, although its stock is limited.
teaching.es: En caso de retraso del proveedor, recurriremos a una tienda local, aunque sus existencias son limitadas.
teaching.explanationEs: In the event of + sustantivo; fall back on = recurrir a una alternativa segura.
segments: In the event of a supplier delay, we will fall
back on a local shop, although its stock is limited.
teaching.audioText: In the event of a supplier delay, we will fall back on a local shop, although its stock is limited.

teaching.en: A shortfall in sales of two thousand dollars would not close the workshop, because the contingency plan covers it.
teaching.es: Un déficit de ventas de dos mil dólares no cerraría el taller, porque el plan de contingencia lo cubre.
teaching.explanationEs: Shortfall es lo que falta para llegar a una cifra esperada; el plan de contingencia dice qué hacer.
segments: A shortfall in sales of two thousand dollars would not
close the workshop, because the contingency plan covers it.
teaching.audioText: A shortfall in sales of two thousand dollars would not close the workshop, because the contingency plan covers it.

teaching.en: Every major risk needs its own answer, since a knock-on effect can turn a small delay into a large shortfall.
teaching.es: Cada riesgo importante necesita su propia respuesta, porque un efecto en cadena puede convertir un pequeño retraso en un gran déficit.
teaching.explanationEs: Knock-on effect es la consecuencia que provoca otras consecuencias; por eso se planifica por riesgo.
segments: Every major risk needs its own answer, since a knock-on
effect can turn a small delay into a large shortfall.
teaching.audioText: Every major risk needs its own answer, since a knock-on effect can turn a small delay into a large shortfall.

teaching.en: Should stock run out, we will buy parts from a local shop; failing that, we will tell customers to come back tomorrow.
teaching.es: Si se agotaran las existencias, compraremos piezas en una tienda local; si eso falla, pediremos a los clientes que vuelvan mañana.
teaching.explanationEs: Failing that introduce el plan B cuando el plan A no funciona; run out = agotarse.
segments: Should stock run out, we will buy parts from a local
shop; failing that, we will tell customers to come back tomorrow.
teaching.audioText: Should stock run out, we will buy parts from a local shop; failing that, we will tell customers to come back tomorrow.

teaching.en: Use the reserve to cushion the blow of a bad winter, but only as a last resort, since a safeguard is not income.
teaching.es: Usa la reserva para amortiguar el golpe de un mal invierno, pero solo como último recurso, porque una salvaguarda no es un ingreso.
teaching.explanationEs: Cushion the blow = reducir el daño de algo; as a last resort = cuando no queda otra opción.
segments: Use the reserve to cushion the blow of a bad winter, but
only as a last resort, since a safeguard is not income.

prompt.es: Completa: «Si lloviera toda una semana, ofreceremos recogida a domicilio.»

feedback.es: Should + sujeto + verbo base sustituye a if en un registro formal: Should it rain = If it rains.

hint.es: Inversión formal: Should + sujeto + verbo base.

origin.text: The workshop depends on dry weather, so the owners have prepared for the worst. ___ it rain for a whole week, we will offer a home pick-up service.

choices.text: Should the supplier is late, we will call another one.
Should the supplier will be late, we will call another one.
Should the supplier be late, we will call another one.

feedback.es: Después de Should el verbo va en forma base (be), sin -s ni will.

hint.es: Tras Should el verbo va en forma base.

origin.text: The owners want a formal sentence that means: if the supplier is late, we will call another one.

prompt.es: Ordena: «En caso de un retraso prolongado, avisaremos a los clientes.»

answer.text: In the event of a long delay, we will warn customers
accepted: In the event of a long delay, we will warn customers
In the event of a long delay we will warn customers

feedback.es: In the event of va seguido de un sustantivo (a long delay) y después de la coma va la acción.

hint.es: Empieza por In the event of.

prompt.es: Según el plan, ¿cuál es el último recurso del taller?

choices.text: Asking the bank for a loan.
Using the cash reserve to pay the rent.

feedback.es: La inversión «only as a last resort will we ask the bank» indica que el préstamo se deja para cuando nada más funciona.

origin.text: Plan B for a wet autumn: Should rain keep customers away for a week, we will offer a home pick-up service. Failing that, we will shorten our opening hours and use the cash reserve to cover the rent, but only as a last resort will we ask the bank for a loan.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige por qué dejan la subida de precios para el final.

choices.text: Because raising prices would only delay the shortfall by a few months.
Because losing customers could make the situation worse instead of solving it.
Because the bank would insist on a price rise before it agreed to a loan.

feedback.es: Subir precios puede hacer perder clientes y provocar un efecto en cadena; por eso se deja para el final.

origin.audio: In the event of a shortfall in sales, we will first draw on the cash reserve for three months. Failing that, we will ask the bank for a short loan. A price rise would be the final option, because losing customers could produce a knock-on effect that the workshop could not afford.

prompt.es: Completa: «En caso de un otoño lluvioso, el taller tiene un plan preparado.»

feedback.es: In the event of + sustantivo es la fórmula formal para «en caso de».

origin.text: The workshop cannot control the weather. In the ___ of a wet autumn, however, it has a plan ready.

prompt.es: Escribe cuatro planes de contingencia breves para tu taller de bicicletas.

answer.text: Should demand fall, we will use our cash reserve and reduce our opening hours. In the event of a supplier delay, we will order parts from a local shop. Should stock run out, we will ask customers to wait. Failing that, we will offer them a discount.
accepted: Should demand fall, we will use our cash reserve and reduce our opening hours. In the event of a supplier delay, we will order parts from a local shop. Should stock run out, we will ask customers to wait. Failing that, we will offer them a discount.

Should sales fall, we will draw on the cash reserve and cut our costs. In the event of a late delivery, we will call another supplier. Should the stock run out, we will borrow parts from a friend's shop. Failing that, we will tell customers to come back tomorrow.

feedback.es: Cada plan necesita una fórmula formal y una acción concreta; el plan B empieza con Failing that.

origin.text: Tienes un taller de bicicletas. Escribe cuatro planes: si baja la demanda (Should…), si el proveedor se retrasa (In the event of…), si se agota el stock (Should…) y un plan B (Failing that,…).

prompt.es: ¿Qué implica el autor con su propuesta de actuar hoy?

choices.text: That the owner is certain the bank will refuse, so the workshop must close.
That waiting until the problem appears would leave too little time to act.
That the cash reserve alone could keep the workshop going until the end of the year.
That the owner regrets having worried too early about the credit line.

feedback.es: Propone el plan hoy y no en marzo, «when it would already be late»: esperar al problema dejaría poco margen para reaccionar.

origin.text: Note from the owner: The bank has warned us that it may not renew the credit line next year. Should that happen, the cash reserve would cover three months of rent, no more. In the event that sales stay flat, I see no realistic way to last until the end of the year. I am therefore proposing a contingency plan today, not in March, when it would already be late. I would rather be told that I worried too early than that I acted too late. If the credit line is renewed, we will have lost nothing but an afternoon; if it is not, we will have bought ourselves a whole year.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige cuál es el último recurso y por qué lo evitan.

choices.text: Turning away a repair, because each lost customer harms the business.
Telling customers to return, because that breaks the promise of the workshop.
Borrowing parts from a friend, because that shop charges extra.

feedback.es: El último recurso es rechazar una reparación, porque cada cliente perdido debilita al taller a largo plazo.

origin.audio: Should the workshop run out of stock in spring, we will borrow parts from a friend's shop. Failing that, we will tell customers to come back the next day, and only as a last resort will we turn away a repair, because every lost customer harms the workshop in the long run.

prompt.es: Completa: «Si eso falla, buscarán otro proveedor que entregue más rápido.»

feedback.es: Failing that introduce la segunda opción cuando la primera no resulta.

origin.text: The owners will first ask the supplier for a discount. ___ that, they will look for another supplier who can deliver faster.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Si bajara la demanda, usaríamos la reserva de efectivo.»

answer.text: Should demand fall, we would use the cash reserve

feedback.es: Should + sujeto + verbo base, y would expresa una posibilidad más hipotética.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase está bien construida y suena formal?

choices.text: In the event that a long shortfall, we will draw on our reserve.
In the event of a long shortfall, we will draw on our reserve.
In the event of a long shortfall happens, we will draw on our reserve.

feedback.es: In the event of exige un sustantivo (a long shortfall); con una oración completa se usa in the event that.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada fórmula con su sentido.

feedback.es: Cada fórmula aporta un matiz: condición formal, caso previsto, plan B y última opción.
